title: tizen collectors?
body: is it possible at all for tizen watches to act as standalone collectors?

comments.body:
no, only android watches.
there is no xdrip/collector version for tizen watches.
yeah i know there is only one for android wear, i was just wondering if there are limitations to tizen to prevent a small collector app that works on tizen
Will xdrip work on a tic watch?
yes, it works on a tic watch (I tried the tic watch s with the miaomiao transmitter).
Right now, I am just using the wearable widget on my Samsung Frontier S3. Would be nice to have a tizen collector
Wearable Widgets works very well getting the info on my s3

yeah i have WW too, it does work to just display what my phone is collecting but a standalone collector app sim to the android wear one would be alot better. i know there are limitations to tizen that android wear doesnt have which may prevent a tizen app being functional like the wear one is...

I don't have a Tizen watch but might want one.  With wear widgets are you able to display your BG readings on the Samsung Gear watch faces all the time?  I mainly want to be able to easily glance at my BG readings all the time.
The WW does have widget you can add, but nothing that will take the place of the watch face all the time.
@ronrosenbaum, [I have described my approach for that in the other ticket](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/460#issuecomment-429366367)

@Mr-Enigma I hope your question has been answered already.
If not, would you please use the support channels for asking questions?
